description: Avoid single-character variable names -- they hurt readability
Cache repeated database lookups inside the request loop
Never interpolate raw user input directly into SQL queries
Avoid bare except clauses that swallow all exceptions silently
Break up functions longer than 50 lines into smaller units
Avoid eval() or exec() on untrusted or user-controlled input
Avoid nested loops over the same collection when a single pass suffices
Separate business logic from HTTP request handling code
Remove leftover debug print/console statements before merging
Validate and sanitize all external input at system boundaries
Use connection pooling instead of opening a new DB connection per request
Avoid tight coupling between the data layer and the presentation layer
Add tests for edge cases such as empty input and boundary values
Use parameterized queries or an ORM instead of string-built SQL
